episode_title: Ferdinand x Dorothea C/B - Why Am I A Bee
source_summary: Dorothea challenges Ferdinand to guess why she dislikes him and says he is like a bee; in the B support he presents self-made pastries as his earnest but wrong solution.

characters.name: Ferdinand
characters.identity_lock: Academy-era Ferdinand: refined orange hair, aristocratic posture, clean youthful face, immaculate Black Eagles academy uniform with gold trim and noble bearing; earnest and formal, not caricatured.

characters.name: Dorothea
characters.identity_lock: Academy-era Dorothea: dark wavy hair under academy cap, mature clever expression, Black Eagles academy uniform; amused and perceptive, never cruel or exaggerated.

frame_intents.start: Dorothea circles lightly around Ferdinand, enjoying the challenge.
frame_intents.key: Dorothea gives the bee clue with a bright, teasing smile.
frame_intents.end: Ferdinand is left alone, visibly overthinking the clue.

dialogue.speaker: Dorothea
dialogue.text: 貴方が訳を当てられたら、正直に認めてあげようかしら。

dialogue.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogue.text: 挑まれたからには当ててみせよう。

dialogue.speaker: Dorothea
dialogue.text: 貴方が蜜蜂のようだから、かしらねえ。

dialogue.speaker: Dorothea
dialogue.text: 後は自分で考えて。じゃあねえ、フェルくん。

dialogue.speaker: Ferdinand
dialogue.text: ううむ、蜜蜂か……。自分の役割を全うしている、ということか？
